title: Motion
description: full = values ease, events flash (a 50 or a miss marks its place on the bar), the results bar grows in. reduced = values and enter/exit still ease; no flashes. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Corner marks
description: The 18-LAB registration marks on the box's top-left and bottom-right corners. neutral = warm white. amber = both in 18-LAB amber. tl = amber, top-left only. none = no marks.

title: Show what osu!'s HUD shows
description: Also show score, accuracy, combo and the per-judgement counts (300/100/50/miss and their equivalents), which osu!'s own HUD already shows. Derived figures (ratios, budgets, misses left) are always shown. Here: the MAX…Miss counts, accuracy and combo under the bar.

title: Keys per second
description: Live and peak keys per second (the same number as key-counter and kps-graph). The results screen keeps the peak of the attempt you just played.

title: Orientation
description: auto picks from the page's shape: a tall box gets the column (the chained ratio, the bar, then counts and stats when shown; the ratio's six terms wrap onto two or three rows when one row does not fit the column, rather than the text shrinking), a box at least twice as wide as tall gets one row (the ratio, counts, stats, the bar underneath) meant to sit centred over the stage.

title: Alignment
description: auto = left for the column, centre for the row. right right-aligns the column's text so it can sit left of the stage (the ratio and the bar keep MAX on the left); for the row it packs the content to that side of the box.
